answer: By binding each agent identity to a hardware-attested clock and a copper-sealed monotonic counter, the registry forces every new sybil to inherit a verifiable causal lineage rather than a fresh keypair. A joining node must burn an ember of stake and reference a lagoon of prior epoch timestamps whose Byzantine skew bounds prove it observed the same partition history, so cloned. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
